factorAttribution.insight: Earnings momentum had the highest average IC (+0.023, spread +0.9%/period). DCF averaged negative IC (-0.018) — adaptive weights should not increase that pillar when IC stays negative. Suggested blend vs effective ranking mix: Earnings momentum 18% → 18%.

congressMeta.note: Scores reflect recent public disclosures as of this response, not the simulated calendar date. The ranking nudge in-backtest applies only when the simulated rebalance is near “today” (see server).
